::: notes
Your turn to be placed. Open the browser lab – everyone, because the workspace does not print this and the lab runs in any browser tab – and rerun try underscore spec with the choices you submitted. The placement line in its output is the same statistic that I computed for the five analysts: the share of the grid of 840 that is more negative than your value. Two or three minutes. Then paste your percentile in chat, hold it, send on go. [go] Look at the range in the chat – the class spans a good stretch of the curve, and every one of you can now say where you stand relative to eight hundred and forty defensible alternatives. That sentence – "my estimate sits at the Nth percentile of the specification space" – is a publishable way to report a robustness check, and you have just done it.
:::
